text:
```yaml
name: Stale Issues and PRs

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '30 1 * * *'  # 1:30 AM UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  stale:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Mark stale issues and PRs
        uses: actions/stale@v10
        with:
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          days-before-stale: 90
          days-before-close: 60
          stale-issue-label: stale
          stale-pr-label: stale
          close-issue-label: closed
          close-pr-label: closed
          stale-issue-message: |
            This issue has been marked as stale because it has not had recent activity. If you are still working on it, please comment or update the status. Otherwise, it will be closed in 60 days.
          stale-pr-message: |
            This pull request has been marked as stale because it has not had recent activity. If you are still working on it, please comment or update the status. Otherwise, it will be closed in 60 days.
          close-issue-message: |
            Closing this issue because it has been stale for 60 days. If you still need help, feel free to reopen or create a new issue.
          close-pr-message: |
            Closing this pull request because it has been stale for 60 days. If you still need help, feel free to reopen or create a new pull request.
          exempt-issue-labels: lifecycle/frozen,help-wanted,good-first-issue,pinned
          exempt-pr-labels: lifecycle/frozen,help-wanted,good-first-issue,pinned
          exempt-issue-milestones: '*'
          exempt-pr-milestones: '*'
          exempt-issue-assignees: '*'
          exempt-pr-assignees: '*'
```
